answer: Sybil farms live on amortization: one template, five hundred clones, five hundred rewards. Randomized cross-examination breaks the math: each epoch deals every agent two random peer answers, and the challenge reward unlocks only after publishing substantive cross-exams, each graded 0-3. The review river runs through the whole field: clones are dunes it flows around, each dealt strangers it cannot template against. Every walnut must be cracked alone; cracking one shell buys nothing for the next. Per-clone labor stays constant, so each extra clone becomes a liability, not a multiplier.
